info.name: Dynamic Form Engine v4
info.description: Detailed Postman collection for dynamic form configuration, multilingual translation setup, localized form rendering, RSP-wise document setup, and document-form generation.

item.name: Form Config Setup
item.description: Core setup APIs. Keep using these for base form setup. Multilingual values should now be configured through the dedicated translation APIs instead of this request.

request.description: Creates a new customer form configuration version. Response metadata is localized from headers when translations exist; otherwise default labels/messages are returned.
Creates a full dynamic form for `KycIndividual` without sending an explicit `fields` list. Keep the body as valid JSON only. Do not paste plain text before the opening `{`.
Returns the active configuration. If `Language: ne` is sent and Nepali translation exists, metadata short/long labels and validation messages are localized; otherwise default values are returned.

item.name: Form Config Translations
item.description: Use these APIs to manage multilingual labels and validation messages without changing the main form-config setup payload.

request.description: Stores normalized translation rows for labels and validation messages. Response is still the same form-config response shape, but localized according to request headers.

item.name: Form Runtime
item.description: Runtime form rendering APIs. These now support localized responses through `Language` or `Accept-Language` headers.

item.name: Relationships
item.description: Valid runtime relationship examples for the KycIndividual -> SupportingDocument scenario.

request.description: Creates the collection-based relationship used by dynamic form generation. Keep the body as valid JSON.

item.name: RSP Wise Document Setup
item.description: Base RSP-wise document setup. This request remains focused on visible/default labels/required setup. Multilingual translation updates go through the dedicated translation API.

item.name: Get RSP Wise Document Setup By Id
RSP Attribute Contracts
item.description: Contract APIs that control which reference models are enabled for a given RSP and module. These drive form-config generation and customized form rendering.

request.description: Creates multiple contract rows for the provided RSP. For document-enabled flows you can also pass minimum document counts.

item.name: List RSP Attribute Contracts By RspId And Module
Get RSP Attribute Contract By Id
RSP Wise Document Translations
item.description: Dedicated API for multilingual document labels and required-message translations.

request.description: Stores only translation rows. Existing boolean response contract remains unchanged for setup APIs, while document-form responses can use these translations through language headers.

item.name: Document Form Runtime
item.description: Dynamic document form metadata built from SupportingDocument target DTO, static metadata, and RSP document setup. Response supports localization via headers.

request.description: If `Language: ne` exists in translation rows, labels and validation messages are returned in Nepali. If not found, default English or base setup labels/messages are returned.

item.name: Relationship Management
item.description: Dynamic relationship management APIs for defining and managing relationships between domain models at runtime.

body.raw:
{
  "relationshipName": "customer_has_transactions",
  "sourceEntity": "Customer",
  "targetEntity": "Transaction",
  "relationshipType": "ONE_TO_MANY",
  "sourceKeyField": "customerId",
  "targetKeyField": "customerId",
  "description": "Relationship between customers and their transactions",
  "active": true,
  "createdBy": "admin"
}

request.description: Creates a new relationship definition between two domain models. This allows runtime configuration of relationships without modifying existing entities.
Retrieves a specific relationship definition by name.
Updates an existing relationship definition.
Deletes a relationship definition.
Retrieves all relationship definitions.
Retrieves all relationship definitions involving a specific entity.
Creates a relationship instance linking two entity instances.
Deletes a relationship instance by ID.
Retrieves all instances of a specific relationship.
Retrieves all entities related to a specific entity through a relationship.
Retrieves all related entities for a specific entity, grouped by relationship.
Validates that a relationship exists between two entity types.
Checks if the relationship service is healthy.
Register a validation configuration for an entity type. Products use this to define their validation rules.

body.raw:
[
  {
    "ruleName": "customerEmailRequired",
    "entityType": "Customer",
    "fieldName": "email",
    "ruleType": "required",
    "message": "Customer email is required"
  },
  {
    "ruleName": "customerPhonePattern",
    "entityType": "Customer",
    "fieldName": "phone",
    "ruleType": "pattern",
    "pattern": "^[+]?[0-9\\s\\-\\(\\)]{7,20}$",
    "message": "Invalid phone number format"
  }
]

request.description: Register multiple validation configurations for an entity type.
Get all validation configurations for an entity type.
Remove all validation configurations for an entity type.
